sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Reservations"."Room" AS e, SUM("Reservations"."Kids") AS m1, AVG("Reservations"."Adults") AS m2, (SUM("Reservations"."Kids") - AVG("Reservations"."Adults")) AS m3 FROM "Reservations" GROUP BY "Reservations"."Room") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
why: total of number of children per Rooms (by Room) (additive)
average of number of adults per Rooms (by Room)
total of number of children minus average of number of adults: both in count of guests on reservation, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
